Brand: Brand Gamma (Trailora)
Document Type: Vendor Evaluation
Date: 2026-01-26
Department: Procurement
Author: Rita Bose, Procurement Specialist

Business Context:
Trailora needs a recycled polyester supplier for the Alpine Softshell Jacket Fall 2026 transition.

Vendors Compared:
1. FiberLoop Mills
   - Recycled content: 100% certified
   - Fabric cost: +22% versus current virgin polyester
   - Lead time: 7 weeks
   - Strength: strong certification and color consistency

2. EcoThread Asia
   - Recycled content: 70% recycled / 30% virgin blend
   - Fabric cost: +11% versus current virgin polyester
   - Lead time: 4 weeks
   - Strength: faster and cheaper

Evaluation Notes:
EcoThread is faster and lower cost, but its 70% blend weakens the sustainability claim Trailora wants to market. FiberLoop costs more and is slower, yet it supports a clearer "certified recycled" message and better matches Strategy's premium eco positioning.

Recommendation:
Select FiberLoop Mills for the initial 40% recycled production run.

Next Step:
Request Decision Committee approval before February 5 so Fall production planning can begin.
